title: Larkspur Memory Care Rate Card: Suites, Care Programs and the Community Fee
content:
Every Memory Care Residency Agreement is written for one tier, and each tier is one suite type combined with one care program. The monthly rate of the tier is all-inclusive: it covers the suite, meals, the care of the program and medication management, and it is quoted in US dollars per calendar month.

## Monthly rates by tier

| Tier | Suite type | Care program | Monthly rate (USD per calendar month) | Maximum residents in the suite |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Memory Care Companion Suite with Essential Care | Companion (shared) | Essential | 6185.00 | 2 |
| Memory Care Companion Suite with Enhanced Care | Companion (shared) | Enhanced | 7060.00 | 2 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Essential Care | Private | Essential | 7645.00 | 1 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Enhanced Care | Private | Enhanced | 8520.00 | 1 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Advanced Care | Private | Advanced | 9390.00 | 1 |
| Memory Care Deluxe Suite with Advanced Care | Deluxe | Advanced | 10265.00 | 1 |

Three suite types appear on the card - companion (a shared suite), private and deluxe - and three care programs - essential, enhanced and advanced. Not every combination is offered: the companion suite comes with the essential or the enhanced program, the private suite with any of the three programs, and the deluxe suite with the advanced program only.

## Community fee

| Tier | One-time community fee at move-in (USD, non-refundable) | Fee waived for a resident moving in directly from a Larkspur independent or assisted living residency |
|---|---|---|
| Memory Care Companion Suite with Essential Care | 5250.00 | Yes |
| Memory Care Companion Suite with Enhanced Care | 5250.00 | Yes |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Essential Care | 5250.00 | Yes |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Enhanced Care | 5250.00 | Yes |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Advanced Care | 5250.00 | Yes |
| Memory Care Deluxe Suite with Advanced Care | 5250.00 | Yes |

## Reading the card

- **Same program, different suite.** Two tiers that share a care program differ only by suite type; for example the essential program costs 6185.00 in a companion suite and 7645.00 in a private suite.
- **Same suite, different program.** Two tiers that share a suite type differ only by care program; in a private suite the essential, enhanced and advanced programs are 7645.00, 8520.00 and 9390.00 respectively.
- **Occupancy.** A companion suite is shared by at most 2 residents; private and deluxe suites hold 1 resident each.
- **Community fee.** The figure is the same 5250.00 on every tier, and every tier carries the waiver for a resident coming directly from a Larkspur independent or assisted living residency.
